title: pericampylus heterophyllus
intro: Pericampylus heterophyllus, commonly known as Kavala, is a plant species belonging to the family Menispermaceae, native to tropical forests in Southeast Asia. The Kavala plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, and it is known to offer several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, the plant is believed to exhibit actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions like pain, digestive issues, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Pericampylus heterophyllus include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
